title: The Witness of the Fens
author: Q. M. Lockridge
blurb: Sebastian Whitlock, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
